label: dense near-always-on feature (all steps after t=0), peaks when copying out u
explanation: Fires on ~92% of all steps and in every sequence. Rate is lowest at t=0 (50%) and t=1 (79%), then ~95-99% for every later step in all phases, with no token, L, or history selectivity in rate (all lifts 0.9-1.1x). The predicate t >= 1 gets F1 ~0.95, but t >= 0 is about as good, so the predicate only describes how dense the feature is, not a specific concept. Magnitude rises with position in the original phase and is highest in the copy phase. The top activations (~9.6) all come when the model is outputting u, especially repeated u u in the copy phase, along with the steps right before such outputs. But u outputs hold only ~4% of the activation mass, so this peak is a small part of what the feature does. It does not have a clear off-condition apart from early original-phase steps.
